remarks: Embrace the LA lifestyle in the heart of Glassell Park! This stunning 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home opens with a light-filled floorplan made for togetherness, where the updated kitchen becomes the natural heart of the home and sunlit living spaces invite long dinners and lazy weekends alike. Both bathrooms have been beautifully refreshed, and with new windows throughout plus modern air conditioning, heating, electrical, and plumbing, everything feels fresh, comfortable, and truly move-in ready. Step outside to your private terraced backyard, with garden beds waiting for your green thumb and a lounging area made for golden-hour evenings under the stars. A 2-car carport adds everyday ease.
